name: Michelle (Chell)

Michelle (Chell) is a master tattoo artist specialized in Japanese and illustrative styles at Insider Tattoo, Edinburgh. Known for her professionalism, she ensures a trouble-free tattooing experience in a clean and safe environment. Her work is not only highly detailed but also meticulously executed, reflecting her high level of skill.
